newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia palm oil ends up on soyoil firmness.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia palm oil ends up on soyoil firmness.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - The market ended higher on firmer soyoil sentiment due to technical rebound after recent falls. Turnover remained small as there was no big players. Forecaster Ivan Wong's crop figures were within expectations and had little impact on market. Dec futures trades in 1,140-1,180 range.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Interest was seen among nearby CPOS and RBD palm oil and olein, with some support from refiners.
Oct (central) was offered at 1,152.50 with bids at 1,147.50 after making earlier sales done at 1,145 and 1,150. Oct (north) saw offers at 1,145 and 1,132.50.
Nov (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,185 ringgit with bids at 1,180. Nov (central) saw offers at 1,165 and bids at 1,155 and Dec (south) at 1,185 with bids at 1,180.
In refined palm oil market, Oct RBD palm oil was offered at $510 a tonne FOB Malaysia and Nov/Dec at $505 and Jan/Feb/Mch at $510. Nov was traded at $500.
Oct palm olein saw offers at $545, Nov/Dec at $535, and Jan/Feb/Mch at $540. October was traded at $542.50 and Nov at $531.50 and $532.50.
Oct RBD palm stearin was offered at $382.50, Nov at $390 and Oct/Nov/Dec palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $330. - Tan Lee Lee (603-230-8911) ($1=2.5020 ringgit).
